text:
Priya (Finance): Quick heads-up: new billing policy rolling to prod on 2026-05-10. Please read and pass to customer-facing docs owners.

Priya (Finance): Summary: introducing a 3-day soft-burst buffer that prevents immediate overage invoices for short spikes, plus an account-level credit rebalance that shifts unused monthly credits into an adaptive pool. We'll add one line on invoices labeled 'soft-burst reconciliation' so customers can see adjustments.

Marco (Billing): Mechanics: soft-burst buffer = 72 hours. Spikes within that window are queued for reconciliation; only sustained over-usage beyond the buffer at month end is billed. Unused credits from low-usage accounts will be rebalanced into a dynamic pool and applied against net overages across the pool.

Jules (Product): This is intended to reduce surprise charges from accidental spikes (e.g., scheduled ETL runs, test jobs). It's not a permanent credit giveaway — we still charge persistent overages.

Ivy (Support): Support playbook: escalate any customer asking for manual reversal with tag 'billing-review'. We have a 1x manual credit option for verified data-migration incidents. Templates posted to #support-templates.

Marco (Billing): Developer notes: webhook payload now includes fields `smoothing_window_start` and `reconciled_tokens`. Use the reconciled_tokens value for billing visualizations. Old tooling that expects raw token==billed token will be inaccurate.

Priya (Finance): Invoice change: CSV columns added: raw_usage, burst_buffer_credit, reconciled_usage, credited_pool_adjustment. The CSV remains backward compatible but please update any ETL.

Jules (Product): Rollout plan: internal alpha this week -> opt-in beta with selected customers 2026-04-20 -> full enforcement 2026-05-10. Beta customers get an "opt-in smoothing" flag in billing settings.

Marco (Billing): Special note for Dedicated customers: contractual terms stay as-is. For enterprise accounts with negotiated caps, we'll not apply pool rebalances unless contract permits.

Ivy (Support): Customer comms: we'll email customers >15k tokens/mo and surface a banner for free accounts. Drafts in /docs/billing/soft-burst-comm.json and shared PR.

ops-bot: Reminder posted: billing rollout checklist due 2026-04-15.

Jules (Product): Metrics to watch: spike in reconciliations, number of manual credit requests, and pool utilization rate. We added metrics: billing.reconciliations.count and billing.pool.utilization.

Marco (Billing): FAQ draft highlights: "Will I get charged more?" -> No, smoothing reduces surprise; "Can I opt out?" -> Only during beta (before 2026-05-10) and select enterprise deals.

Priya (Finance): Compliance: Finance will store reconciliations for audit and GAAP treatment. If you need transaction-level exports DM Marco.

Ivy (Support): If you have customers who need a one-off heads-up, reply with customer name + rep and we'll coordinate outbound.

Marco (Billing): Links: internal policy -> /docs/internal/billing/soft-burst-buffer.md ; rollout PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/523 ; example CSV -> https://s3.redwood.company/samples/soft-burst-example.csv

Priya (Finance): Please review and flag any blockers by EOD Friday. Thanks! :raised_hands:
